page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal note in the left margin beside the line "dente judicio". Running head at the top, page number at the top left. Catchword at the bottom right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: Hovetmannos cognitores caufam agerent ordinario modo usque ad momentum ferendæ sententiæ: Hovetmannos juffit acta ea omnia exhibere sibi: interea Oldermanuus id observaret, quod ante erat mandatum. Quod ipsum cum iniquius putarent oppidani de Oldermanno (nam extractum iri in longum actionem rebantur, atque interea sine nervo futurum jus civitatis) rem ad Margaretam Parmensem gubernatricem Belgii retulerunt. Illa cum senatu suo commodè interpretata sententiam Arembergii benignè respondit, mandavitque ut ab Oldermanno damnati cautionem præstarent in eventum litis de solvendo judicato: & simul quæ species terum[?] venalium litigiosarum intelligerentur sententiâ Arembergii comprehensæ. Id factum Bruxellæ die xiv Maij, anno M. p. LXI. Post quæ pendente judicio rursus institutæ actiones Philippus Cobelius.amicæ ad componendam controversiam, demumque hujus ergo cum mandatis in urbem missus Philippus Cobelius ex se-creto senatu regio: cujus prudentiâ & industriâ effectum, ut in capita certa, de

page.notes: The word "terum" after "quae species" is doubtful; it may be a printed form of "rerum". The left marginal note "Philippus Cobelius." is printed in two short lines and is placed at the line "dente judicio". The word "Oldermanuus" is printed as shown. Some small-caps and ligatures are normalised; the catchword "quibus" is kept out of the text.
